subject: US-228: Customer Invoice Portal Implementation
description:
# US-228: Customer Invoice Portal Implementation

Implement self-service customer invoice portal with secure access tokens. Features: email-based token delivery, invoice viewing/filtering, PDF downloads, correction requests, mobile-responsive UI. 

**Technical Tasks**: Access token system (24-48h expiration), 6 portal API endpoints, portal UI with filters, security (rate limiting, audit logging). 

**Acceptance Criteria**: Token-based access, invoice list/view/download, correction requests, audit trail, 30-40% support ticket reduction.

**Effort**: 16-18 hours

subject: US-229: Invoice Correction Workflows
description:
# US-229: Invoice Correction Workflows

Implement complete correction system: adjustments (modify line items), credit memos (partial refunds), void (cancel invoice). All corrections preserve original invoice for audit trail.

**Technical Tasks**: 3 correction types, 5 API endpoints, database schema, workflow logic, UI components.

**Acceptance Criteria**: Create adjustments/credits/voids, preserve originals, complete audit trail, notifications sent, accounting system updated.

**Effort**: 14-16 hours

subject: US-230: Multi-Currency Invoice Support
description:
# US-230: Multi-Currency Invoice Support

Implement real-time currency conversion with historical rate storage. Support 50+ currencies via exchangerate-api.io.

**Technical Tasks**: API integration, conversion logic, exchange_rates table, currency display in PDFs, team default currency.

**Acceptance Criteria**: Real-time conversion, 50+ currencies, 24h rate caching, locked rates at invoice creation, fallback to cached rates.

**Effort**: 12-14 hours

subject: US-231: Accounting System Export & Integration
description:
# US-231: Accounting System Export & Integration

Implement CSV/Excel export and QuickBooks/Xero OAuth integrations with automatic sync.

**Technical Tasks**: CSV/Excel export with filtering, QuickBooks OAuth + sync, Xero OAuth + sync, webhook handling, token refresh automation.

**Acceptance Criteria**: Export functionality, OAuth connections, invoice sync, webhook handling, error retry logic.

**Business Value**: Save 10+ hours/month for finance team.

**Effort**: 18-20 hours

subject: US-232: Invoice Management Database Migration
description:
# US-232: Invoice Management Database Migration

Migrate from mock in-memory stores to production PostgreSQL. Create 8 tables with Alembic migrations.

**Tables**: invoice_preferences, invoice_corrections, invoice_portal_tokens, tax_configurations, tax_exemptions, exchange_rates, accounting_integrations, invoice_audit_log.

**Technical Tasks**: Create SQLAlchemy models, Alembic migrations, refactor all CRUD operations, add indexes.

**Acceptance Criteria**: All mock stores removed, database CRUD operational, <100ms queries, rollback capability.

**Effort**: 12-14 hours

subject: US-233: Custom Invoice Branding & Styling
description:
# US-233: Custom Invoice Branding & Styling

Implement custom branding: team logos, colors, footer text, payment instructions, QR codes.

**Technical Tasks**: Branding model, logo upload/resize, color validation, PDF enhancement, preview functionality, UI dashboard.

**Customizable**: Company logo, primary/secondary colors, footer, payment terms, custom fields, QR code.

**Acceptance Criteria**: Upload logos, customize colors, preview changes, accessibility compliance, all invoices use branding.

**Effort**: 10-12 hours

subject: US-234: Advanced Tax Configuration UI
description:
# US-234: Advanced Tax Configuration UI

Implement multi-jurisdiction tax configuration with exemptions and compliance.

**Features**: Multiple tax rates per team, jurisdiction-based selection, tax exemption certificates, reverse charge mechanism, automatic rate lookup.

**Technical Tasks**: Tax configuration UI, exemption management, multi-jurisdiction logic, address-based tax selection, test calculator.

**Acceptance Criteria**: Configure multiple jurisdictions, upload exemption certificates, automatic tax selection, preview calculations.

**Effort**: 10-12 hours

subject: US-235: SPEC-028 Comprehensive Testing Suite
description:
# US-235: SPEC-028 Comprehensive Testing Suite

Implement complete test coverage for SPEC-028 unique features (separate from SPEC-027 tests).

**Test Categories**: Unit tests (30-40 tests), integration tests (15-20 tests), E2E tests (5-8 scenarios).

**Coverage Areas**: Customer portal flow, invoice corrections, multi-currency, accounting export, database operations, branding, tax configuration.

**Target**: 80% code coverage for SPEC-028-specific features.

**Acceptance Criteria**: Full test suite, 80% coverage, separate from SPEC-027, CI integration.

**Effort**: 14-16 hours
